data.title: 风见一姬 · 素银残局的深思独白
data.action: 半靠在深色绒面躺椅上，修长指尖托着一枚黑曜石棋子，银白发丝垂散在肩侧，透光薄纱随呼吸微起伏，清冷美眸静静审视着棋盘对面的来客。
data.location: 私人书斋躺椅畔，百叶窗透入冷色月光与黑白棋盘相伴
data.lighting: 银白冷月穿过百叶窗格投下黑白相间的条纹光影，轮廓光勾勒修长身段
data.mood: 清冷知性，沉着神秘而充满支配感
data.description: 私人书斋躺椅畔，百叶窗透入冷色月光与黑白棋盘相伴。半靠在深色绒面躺椅上，修长指尖托着一枚黑曜石棋子，银白发丝垂散在肩侧，透光薄纱随呼吸微起伏，清冷美眸静静审视着棋盘对面的来客。 她微微抬眸轻语——“将死之前还有三步，雄二。这盘棋……你还要继续看下去，还是直接认输投降呢？”
data.promptProse: Seen from a high oblique angle inside a quiet private study, Kazuki lounges across a dark velvet chaise holding an obsidian chess piece as cold moonlight through venetian blinds casts crisp striped shadows over the chessboard.
data.animaCaption: Reclining on a dark velvet chaise lounge beside a moonlit chessboard barred with venetian-blind shadows, she balances an obsidian chess piece between slender fingers wearing a minimalist charcoal-grey silk camisole slip with a sheer mesh chest panel.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an understated charcoal-grey silk slip nightdress with ultra-thin spaghetti straps, a silver clasp, and geometric sheer-mesh chest cutouts over her bare collarbones.
